links.outcome: LLM performance on licensing-level exam questions versus more complex tasks
links.effect: Qwen3-235B-A22B achieved over 90% accuracy on licensing-level questions, but performance declined ~15% as task complexity increased, revealing limitations in complex reasoning.
links.quote: State-of-the-art models performed well on foundational knowledge, with Qwen3-235B-A22B achieving over 90% accuracy on licensing-level questions, but performance declined ~15% as task complexity increased, revealing limitations in complex reasoning.

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an evaluation benchmark (PEDIASBench) evaluating 12 LLMs on pediatric knowledge, clinical reasoning, safety, and ethics.
